title: 第19章 富婆饿饿饭饭第20章 法相术万岁狐王
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 回到黄风岭后，叶云正准备炼丹，没想到老猴妖回来了。
向他禀告这些日子，居住在那里人族的变化。
“大王，最近那里又来了一批人族，双方因为地盘食物等原因打起来了，我等要暗中插手吗？”
“不必，人族内部争斗不必理会，只需要庇护不受天灾侵害，以及防止野兽妖怪等伤害他们就行。”
叶云轻声开口道，人族内部争斗，这是发展必然要经历的，无须插手。
“明白了，大王。”
老猴妖自是坚定执行自家大王的命令。
“嗯，等他们稳定之后，你便可以带领小妖们暗中传播我黄风大王的名号，不过还是那句话，循序渐进就行。”
“好的。”
老猴妖随即行礼退下，不过临走前，叶云赐予了一些法力给对方。
主要是丹药被他用完了，只能等下次再赐给老猴妖了。
目送着老猴妖离去，叶云心中沉思，等自己的名号在那些人族里传播开后，拥有了初步信仰。
自己可以适当降下一些所谓神迹，帮助这些人族更好更快的发展。
“之后也可以教化他们，甚至将我前世的那些知识教给他们一些……”
如此一来，对他的信仰必然更加坚固，到时候庇护所产生的功德之力，也会更可观。
而有了这些功德之力，距离他打造后天功德至宝的目标，就更进一步了。
至于凝聚出功德法相，功德化身这些，所需要消耗的功德之力就是海量了。
没看到天庭掌控那么多人族，佛门发展出那么多人族信徒，都没几个凝聚出功德法相和功德化身。
叶云就算未来完全掌控流沙国，所产生的功德之力都完全不够。
所以，先将后天功德至宝弄出来，功德法相和化身的事情，只能之后再慢慢谋划了。
将这些念头压下，叶云取出天材地宝，开始继续用铁锅炼丹。
而在叶云炼丹的时候，刚刚抵达黄风岭附近的少女，忽然嗅到了丹药的香气。
顿时似秋水般的双眸一亮。
“好浓郁的丹药香气，怎么感觉比我父亲给我的丹药还要香。”
“这荒郊野岭的，竟有家伙在炼丹，而且炼的丹药还这般好。”
怀着好奇，少女立刻朝着散发丹药香气的黄风岭而去。
然后她就看到了守在黄风岭上的一些小妖们。
不过少女拥有隐匿法宝，所以这些小妖们根本无法发现她。
就这样，少女轻松越过这些小妖们，来到了黄风岭深处。
接着她便看到了在洞府外用铁锅炼丹的叶云，一张小嘴顿时张成了“O”
型。
她也见过自家父亲请一些奇人异士炼丹时的场面。
哪个不是用着华丽且精美的丹炉。
结果眼前这个家伙，竟然在用铁锅在炼丹！
不过少女立刻判断出，这家伙用铁锅炼制的丹药，比那些奇人异士用丹炉正儿八经炼制出来的丹药，品质要好的多！
这不由令少女内心震动，这家伙炼丹水平得有多高！
content_en:
After returning to Huangfengling, Ye Yun was preparing to make elixirs, but he didn't expect the old monkey demon to come back.
Tell him about the changes in the human race living there in these days.
"Your Majesty, a group of humans have recently arrived there, and the two sides are fighting over territory, food, and other reasons. Are we going to intervene secretly?"
"No, don't worry about the internal fighting among the human race. We only need to protect them from natural disasters and prevent beasts, monsters, etc. from harming them."
Ye Yun spoke softly and said that the internal struggles of the human race are inevitable for development and there is no need to intervene.
"I understand, Your Majesty."
The old monkey demon resolutely carried out his king's orders.
"Well, once they are stable, you can lead the little demons to secretly spread my name as King Huangfeng, but again, just do it step by step."
"Okay."
The old monkey demon immediately bowed and left, but before leaving, Ye Yun gave him some magic power.
Mainly because he had used up the elixir and could only wait until next time to give it to the old monkey demon.
Watching the old monkey demon leave, Ye Yun pondered in his heart. After his name spread among those human races, he gained initial faith.
I can properly send some so-called miracles to help these human races develop better and faster.
"I can also educate them later, and even teach them some of the knowledge from my previous life..."
In this way, the belief in him will definitely be stronger, and the power of merit generated by the shelter will be even more impressive.
And with the power of these merits, he is one step closer to his goal of creating a treasure of acquired merits.
As for condensing the Dharma of merit and the incarnation of merit, the power of merit that needs to be consumed is huge.
I didn’t see that Heaven controls so many human races, and Buddhism has developed so many human race believers, but few of them have condensed the Dharma and the incarnation of merit.
Even if Ye Yun completely controls the Quicksand Kingdom in the future, the power of merit generated will not be enough.
Therefore, we must first find out the treasure of acquired merits and virtues, and we can only slowly plan for the matters of merits, Dharma, and incarnation later.
Suppressing these thoughts, Ye Yun took out the treasures of heaven and earth and continued to use the iron pot to make elixirs.
…
While Ye Yun was refining the elixir, the girl who had just arrived near Huangfengling suddenly smelled the aroma of the elixir.
Suddenly his eyes lit up like autumn water.
"The aroma of the elixir is so rich, it feels even more fragrant than the elixir my father gave me."
"There is a guy in the wilderness refining elixirs, and the elixirs he makes are so good."
Out of curiosity, the girl immediately headed towards Huangfengling, which smelled of elixirs.
Then she saw some little demons guarding Huangfengling.
However, the girl has a hidden magic weapon, so these little monsters cannot detect her at all.
In this way, the girl easily passed these little monsters and arrived deep in Huangfengling.
Then she saw Ye Yun who was making elixirs in an iron pot outside the cave, and his small mouth suddenly opened into an "O"
type.
She had also seen the scene when her father invited some strange people to make elixirs.
Which one is not using a gorgeous and exquisite alchemy furnace.
As a result, the guy in front of me was actually making elixirs in an iron pot!
However, the girl immediately judged that the elixirs refined by this guy using an iron pot were of much better quality than those elixirs refined by those strange people using elixir furnaces!
This can't help but shock the girl's heart. How high is this guy's alchemy skills!
